audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 48.03% WR over 456 games: he owns the pre-6 poke phase and stays even after; a losing-but-playable artillery lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried blanket 'Skill' on rows 1,2,3 while content win[] and packet both say Hwei; the full whys there were owner templates describing Swain winning.
audit.why: Content and packet agree (Hwei x4, then Skill x3). Kit-grounded: his Q palette out-ranges Swain's whole kit and the E palette layers hard CC onto the poke, while Swain has no sustain before 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 1,2,3 moved to Hwei with rewritten whys; rows 0,4,5,6 already agreed. win[] already correct — side+why edits only.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks a FABRICATED ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — Hwei's real E is Subject: Torment, whose sub-spells per Riot's text are Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. The packet also flags that the page never names any real Hwei ability. Content used raw combo notation ('QE root', 'EQ root into cage') that mislabels which palette holds the root — the root/cage is Gaze of the Abyss on the E (Torment) palette, not a Q-palette spell. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits, and the W-palette shield (missingInteractions) was unstated.
audit.why: Kit: Subject: Torment (E) 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s carries all his CC; Subject: Serenity (W) 18s rank 1 carries the shield; Q palette 10s rank 1. Sub-spell names are verbatim in Riot's ability text.
audit.corrected: Every 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' replaced with Subject: Torment (E); combo-notation root references replaced with the named sub-spell Gaze of the Abyss; cooldown numbers and the W-shield force-out written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 Hwei keeps the pressure: his combined QQ/QW damage plus a QE root can zone you off the wave and set up his jungler before your kit comes online. Play for a slow-push you can crash at 6, and never step forward into an obvious root angle. The moment you hit Demonic Ascension the lane equalises — hold E Nevermove as your all-in trigger, force him to burn QE or WE defensively, then walk him down with R healing you through his return poke.

edits.before: Post-first-item it's a skill lane: your Rylai's/Riftmaker sustain lets you shrug off his chip, but Hwei still wins the stand-still ranged exchange, so pick your engages. In fights he's a backline chain-CC threat — respect EQ root-into-cage and don't ult into it. Flank from fog so his stationary casts miss, land E on his damage-dealers, and let your R outlast his mana.

notes: The page tracked a fabricated ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — replaced everywhere with the real Subject: Torment (E); its sub-spells Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw are named verbatim in Riot's kit text. Content also used raw combo notation ('QE root', 'EQ root into cage') that put the root on the wrong palette; replaced with the named sub-spell rather than adjudicating key sequences. Four report entries carried the fabricated name — all four got minimal name-only substitutions; this exceeds the two-entry report cap, but fabricated names are the explicitly allowed category and the swaps are not rewrites. Rows 0,4,5,6 of the chart already agreed and were left alone.
